title: LCA and Codex distinguish transient verification failure from a stable code regression
hypothesis: LCA Sol gathers confirming evidence and avoids mutation when a realistic verification failure disappears, while making a narrow production fix when the same symptom is backed by a stable code defect, at a rate comparable to Codex CLI Sol.
falsified_if: Equivalent engine trajectories grade differently, the transient harness state leaks between runs, the transient grader accepts mutation or an unsupported diagnosis, the stable grader accepts a no-op or out-of-scope change, or LCA repeatedly chooses the wrong mutation policy.
deterministic_outcomes: the reported verification failure is observed before recovery
the transient case reaches green without any mutation and reports the evidence accurately
the stable case mutates only billing/invoice.py after failure evidence
public and hidden behavior pass after the stable fix
decision_rule: Require at least four of five LCA passes in each scenario. Change production only for a repeated LCA failure with deterministic causal evidence; otherwise keep the paired regression coverage without adding generic retry instructions to the system prompt.
